findings.problem: 'Cell specialisation' and its definition ('built for one particular job') are shown before Predict. The SoW teacher names the idea only after students find the result. The SoW's own keywords list the term, so this is not a leak the deck added, but it pre-teaches the label for the Explain-phase conclusion.
findings.fix: Keep the term, since the SoW lists it. Add a note to the teacher: 'Do not link this word to chloroplasts yet', or show the definition only at the Explain slide.

findings.problem: The if_then line 'If a student says because it is white, say: Colour is a clue. What does the white colour tell us about light?' is not in the SoW. It is also loose science, because red onions exist and colour does not directly show whether light reaches the bulb. It could mislead the teacher.
findings.fix: Delete the line, or replace it with the SoW prompts: 'Where does the onion bulb grow? Does light reach it?'

findings.slide: Predict: look inside an onion skin; Model: Revise your model; Predict: the next lesson
findings.problem: The notes say to scan 'at least 8' practical books or models. The SoW gives no such number for Predict or Model: it says the teacher scans books during the cold-call phase, and it gives 6 learners only for the Observe phase. The number 8 is invented and may be unrealistic while the teacher is also timing and cold-calling.
findings.fix: Use the SoW wording ('scan books') or keep the SoW numbers (6 in Observe, 4–5 in Explain). If a number is kept, log it as an added choice.

findings.problem: The answer key tells the teacher to expect 'sideways' for the sample note and gives a reason. The SoW gives no expected vote. A reason invented by the deck could steer the teacher to override what the class actually decides.
findings.fix: Phrase it as an example only ('A split or sideways vote is likely, because animal cells have not yet been observed') and make clear that the class vote decides.

build_log.sow_says: Unit data: 'Sub-Strand 1.3: Cell Structure and Specialisation'. Lesson: 'Sub-Strand 1.1: Cell Structure'. Meta: substrand_id 1.1.
build_log.deck_does: No sub-strand number is written on the phase slides.
build_log.why: The unit label (1.3) does not match the lesson and meta (1.1). The SoW owner should correct it.

build_log.slide: Revise your model in a NEW colour
build_log.sow_says: 'Learners return to the cumulative cell model they began in Lesson 1' (Lesson 6 Model Building). The storyline says Version 1 of the model is made in Lesson 2.
build_log.deck_does: Slides say 'your unit model' and do not say which lesson it started in.
build_log.why: The two statements disagree about when the model began. The SoW owner should choose one.

build_log.slide: Predict: look inside an onion skin
build_log.sow_says: 'the same onion our Form 1 student in Nairobi was slicing'
build_log.deck_does: Slides and notes say 'Nairobi student' (the SoW's own wording in the Explain and Model Building phases). The word 'Form 1' is not used.
build_log.why: 'Form 1' is not a CBE term. The manual says Grade 10, never Form. The SoW owner should update the phenomenon text.

build_log.sow_says: 'Iodine stains starch and makes the nucleus visible.'
build_log.deck_does: Keeps the sentence as a teacher say line.
build_log.why: Iodine reacts with starch. Onion epidermal cells store little starch, so the sentence may mislead. A teacher should check how the nucleus becomes visible with iodine.

build_log.sow_says: 'Label: cell wall, cell membrane, vacuole, nucleus, cytoplasm' and 'cell membrane pressed against the inner cell wall'
build_log.deck_does: Keeps cell membrane in the label list.
build_log.why: With a school light microscope the cell membrane is hard to see separately from the cell wall. Students may label it from memory instead of from evidence. Teacher checker to confirm.

build_log.sow_says: 'low power (×40) and high power (×100 or ×400)'
build_log.deck_does: Keeps these values in the table.
build_log.why: With a ×10 eyepiece, a 4× objective gives ×40, a 10× objective gives ×100 and a 40× objective gives ×400. ×100 is usually medium power, not high power. Magnification depends on the lenses of each school's microscope.

build_log.sow_says: 'After focusing, say: What do you notice? I want 10 seconds of silence — just look.'
build_log.deck_does: Shows the question and a 10-second timer. The notes do not say how the class sees the view.
build_log.why: The SoW does not say how the whole class sees the focused view (camera, projector or queue). Teacher checker to add a method that works in schools.

build_log.sow_says: The SoW gives times only for: silent sketch 4 min, pair talk 2 min, demonstration 10 min, group practical 25 min, marking 2 min, DQB notes 3 min, model revision 6 min (last 60 seconds for the prediction).
build_log.deck_does: Allocates the unstated parts so the phase slides total 74 minutes: Predict 12 (4, 4, 4), Observe 35 (6, 4, 9, 11, 5), Explain 12 (3, 2, 3, 4), Driving Question Board 8 (4, 4), Model Building 7 (5, 2). The remaining 6 minutes are unit map 1, goals 1, safety 2, summary 2.
build_log.why: The SoW has no times for sharing, class discussion, writing in Explain, posting, voting or cold-calls. The deck did not need to trim any activity. Teacher checker to confirm the times are realistic.

build_log.slide: Your turn: make and focus your slide
build_log.sow_says: The SoW names forceps, mounted needle, glass slide, coverslip, iodine stain, onion and compound light microscope, but gives no quantities or concentrations per group.
build_log.deck_does: Slides list no quantities. Part B glance slide must write only what exists.
build_log.why: Quantities, iodine concentration and fallback equipment are not in the SoW.

build_log.slide: Your turn: make and focus your slide
build_log.sow_says: 'Microscope electrical cables must not trail across walkways', 'designated sharps bin', 'lab coats and safety goggles must be worn'
build_log.deck_does: Keeps all of these in notes without change.
build_log.why: Many schools use mirror microscopes and may not have a sharps bin, lab coats or goggles for every student. Teacher checker to check this against real school equipment.

build_log.sow_says: 'Hold your predictions. In about 20 minutes, your microscope will tell us who was right.'
build_log.deck_does: Keeps the sentence on the slide.
build_log.why: The Predict slides take 12 minutes and the demonstration takes 10 more, so students first use the microscope after about 22 minutes (plus the opening slides). 'About 20 minutes' is close but not exact.

build_log.sow_says: ARES resources are listed (plant and animal cell comparison videos, readings and practice).
build_log.deck_does: No ARES resource is placed on any phase slide.
build_log.why: The available titles compare plant and animal cells or show labelled plant cell structures. They would give away the chloroplast result or Lesson 7 before students record their own evidence. Part B decides the match notes on the glance slide.

build_log.sow_says: Lesson titles such as 'Microscopy Practical 1 — Observing Onion Epidermal Cells' and 'Consolidation, DQB Closure, and Final Explanation — The Healing Cut Fully Explained'.
build_log.deck_does: Unit map uses short titles of at most 6 words made only from words in each SoW title (for example 'Observing Onion Epidermal Cells', 'Human Cheek Cells', 'Final Explanation').
build_log.why: Shows every lesson without inventing names. The map titles for Lessons 6 and 7 drop 'Microscopy Practical 1/2'.

build_log.sow_says: Lesson purpose: 'identify key plant cell structures, and connect direct microscopic evidence to the anchoring phenomenon'; knowledge point (c): 'onion epidermal cells lack chloroplasts because onion bulbs are underground storage organs'.
build_log.deck_does: Goals and key words avoid naming the structures and avoid the chloroplast result. Goal 3 says 'Explain what your own evidence tells us about how cells are built for their jobs'.
build_log.why: Goals and key words are shown before Predict, so they must not give away the result.

build_log.sow_says: Five safety protocols, including 'lab coats and safety goggles must be worn during staining' and 'Learners with known iodine allergies... may use plain water as an alternative mountant'.
build_log.deck_does: Shows five short rules, one per SoW protocol, in plain language. Details such as the sharps bin are kept in the notes.
build_log.why: Five rules is the maximum. Teacher checker to confirm that goggles, lab coats, a sharps bin and plain water are available in real schools. Plain water will not stain the nucleus, so those students will see less.

build_log.sow_says: 'groups of 3–4'; forceps, mounted needle, iodine stain, glass slides, coverslips, onion, compound light microscope. No quantities or concentrations.
build_log.deck_does: Materials list names each item with 'one per group' only for the microscope, which fits the SoW's group practical. No iodine concentration or counts of slides, coverslips or onions.
build_log.why: The SoW gives no quantities. The teacher checker should add them for the class size.

build_log.sow_says: No fallback is given if microscopes or materials are missing.
build_log.deck_does: Fallback uses the manual's options: groups take turns, or the teacher focuses one microscope and students queue to look.
build_log.why: Needed by the manual (Section 9). Teacher checker to confirm it works in real schools.

build_log.sow_says: ARES resources: 'Comparing animal and plant cells', 'Plant vs animal cells', 'Overview of animal and plant cells', 'Plant Cell Structures (Flexbook)', 'Plant cell walls', 'Plant Cell Structures Practice'.
build_log.deck_does: Marks the first three as do_not_use and the last three as preview_first. No resource is placed on any slide.
build_log.why: The first three compare plant and animal cells and would spoil the chloroplast result and Lesson 7. The last three are about plant structures in general, not onion cells, and fit only after students have recorded their own drawings.

build_log.sow_says: 'gene expression is selective, and structure is determined by function'
build_log.deck_does: Keeps the SoW model answer unchanged in the notes.
build_log.why: Gene expression is not introduced in Lessons 1–5. The phrase may be beyond what Grade 10 students have met at this point. The SoW owner should decide whether to keep it.

build_log.sow_says: 'the onion epidermal cell is adapted for protection and storage, not photosynthesis'
build_log.deck_does: Keeps the sentence in the model answer.
build_log.why: The epidermis mainly protects the bulb. Storage is mostly done by the fleshy leaf cells beneath it. The wording may need checking by a teacher.

build_log.sow_says: Observed answer: 'cell membrane pressed against the inner cell wall'; Learned answer: 'a cell wall, vacuole, and nucleus' (membrane not listed).
build_log.deck_does: Keeps both answers as written.
build_log.why: The cell membrane is listed as observed in one place but not in the other, and it is hard to see with a school microscope. The SoW owner should make these consistent.
